subject.why: The arched railing with colourful heart locks and a central golden heart padlock is immediately recognisable and complete.

category.why: The base environment features rocky, grassy riverbanks on either side instead of a single clear strip at the bottom, violating the rule against rocks and terrain.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, frames, or characters are present.

framing.why: The bridge spans almost the entire width of the frame, crowding the left and right edges without sufficient margins.

colour.why: Colours are bright, saturated, and warm, and the dark railing and colourful locks separate cleanly from the blue sky.

detail.why: Shapes are chunky and simplified without unwanted micro-textures or busy patterns.

style.why: The render matches the reference cards with smooth 3D volumes, soft satin sheen, and no outlines.

fix: Scale down the bridge so it has clear margins on the left and right, and replace the rocky grassy banks with a simple, continuous strip of water across the bottom.
